files.verdict: OK TO SUBMIT AS A MEASURED PROBE - format-legal on the bytes re-read from disk (single band float32 EPSG:32611 3730x3292, sample geotransform, 0 NaN, 0 outside [0,1], nodata null), provably isolated (0 of 14,765 dots receives any kernel mass from another dot), 0.0% on the mapped catalogue, and unique against 475 harvested comparators (max |rho| 0.0128, worst 3-px-dilated Jaccard 0.0918). It is a probe and not a validated gain: no local instrument can rank it, because the catalogue-based holdout is structurally zero for any field that obeys the exclusion the calibration demands (IR-62-H62R-02).
files.note: 14,765 unit dots, 300 m minimum separation by greedy thinning, so every dot's kernel k(d)=max(1-d/300m,0) is exactly 0 against every other dot: max kernel mass received from other dots is 0.000000 and the minimum nearest-neighbour distance is 300.000000 m (measured two independent ways - k-d tree and convolution). Off-catalogue: 0.0% of dots within 300 m of a mapped fault, median 2,062 m. Unique against 475 harvested registry comparators: max |tie-aware Spearman| 0.0128, worst symmetric 3-px-dilated Jaccard 0.0918 (GEMSDOE42__docs_downloads_gems42-xscale-worm-persistence-20261006T000541Z-nan.tif), 0 comparators over the 0.70 overlap limit among the non-vacuous; 14 comparators are flagged vacuous because their own 3-px dilation covers >=70% of the footprint (IR-62-22). Method: four Lahontan levels detected from the DEM (1455/1389/1325/1278 m), a robust tile-mode isobase per level, steps flagged in the physical 15-140 m throw window, and a Hough vote requiring the flagged pixels of >=2 distinct levels on one common line. The lateral-deflection leg of the lane is a measured NULL at a 1.2 km lever arm (IR-62-DEFL-01).
files.submission_note: H62-R: 4 measured Lahontan datum levels, collinear steps on >=2 levels, 14,765 isolated off-catalogue dots. Legal; probe.
files.expected_value_label: no score claimed - no local instrument in this repository can rank this field. The catalogue-based holdout is structurally vacuous for it (IR-62-H62R-02): the exclusion radius and the metric kernel radius are both 300 m, so a dot that obeys the exclusion has kernel weight exactly 0 against every mapped fault, and the field scores 0.000000 where its equal-budget random-dot control scores 0.0287

files.verdict: FORMAT PROBE TWIN, NOT THE SUBMISSION - the same dot set as the -zeros file encoded with NaN outside the footprint and a NaN nodata tag, so it fails this repository's stricter convention (no_nodata_tag, no_nan_anywhere) and is kept only to keep the two encodings of one field comparable.
